title: Validity of a selected component label
statement: Let $G$ be a finite unique game with at least one available label, and fix a connected component. If that component has at least one valid root label, then the selected component label is valid.
hypotheses_covered: A finite unique game with finite nonempty vertex and constraint sets, distinct endpoints, and a permutation attached to each constraint
At least one valid root label exists for that component
